application_type_full: Tree works: Trees in conservation areas/subject to TPOs
description:
****COMMUNAL TREES****

T1 Horse Chestnut (Aesculus hippocastanum)	Overhanging chimney - Reduce away from building to give 3m clearance.
     Final height = unchanged at 15m and final spread = 9m	

T2	Tree Of Heaven (Alianthus altissima)	Overhanging chimney building and lower adjacent building - Reduce away from building by 3m. 
         Final height = unchanged at 15m and final spread = 9m		

G3	Sycamore & 2 x Holly	Overhanging playing hall - Reduce any overhang back to the boundary, removing approx. 1-2m of growth.
        Final height = unchanged at 6m and final spread = 3m	

G4	Sycamore (Acer pseudoplatanus)	Overhanging garden at south end of playing hall - Raise crown to give 3m clearance, reduce spread over garden back 
        by 3m.  Final height = unchanged at 10m and final spread = 6m
